title: How to Assign Multiple Delivery Orders in Swash Laundry Software
description:
How to Use Multi Assign Delivery in Swash Laundry Software (SLS)

Welcome to the official Swash Laundry Software (SLS) tutorial series.

In this video, you'll learn how to use the Multi Assign Delivery feature in Swash Laundry Software. This feature allows you to assign multiple delivery orders to a rider or employee at once, making the delivery process faster, more organized, and more efficient.

In this video, you'll learn:
How to open the Multi Assign Delivery module
How to select multiple delivery orders
How to assign orders to a rider or employee
How to save the delivery assignment
How to verify assigned delivery orders
Best practices for managing multiple deliveries efficiently
